_about: Global business details. Edit here and run `npm run build`. Every value below was taken from the live WordPress site on 17 Oct 2026; see sourceUrl fields.
name: Credtech Solutions
tagline: Your Vision, Our Expertise: Unlock New Possibilities with Credtech Solutions.
shortDescription: Credtech Solutions, based in Delhi NCR, is a trusted marketing and PR agency specialising in SEO, digital marketing, brand building and media outreach. We help businesses boost online visibility, drive traffic and grow their brand with data-driven strategies.

contact.phoneNote: The live site shows the number without a country code. +91 is assumed for the tel: link.
contact.postalCodeNote: Postcode taken from the Google Maps pin linked on the live Contact page.

forms._howTo: Paste a form endpoint (Google Apps Script web app for a Google Sheet: see integrations/google-sheets/README.md; or Formspree, Getform, Basin, Web3Forms) into `endpoint`. The site POSTs FormData with Accept: application/json and only shows a success message when the endpoint returns a 2xx response. Leave it empty and the forms explain that online sending is not connected and offer the visitor an email draft instead.

analytics._howTo: Optional. Add a GA4 measurement ID (G-XXXXXXX). The live WordPress site uses Google Site Kit; its ID was not exposed in the public HTML.

three._howTo: `local` serves the bundled copy in /vendor/three (recommended). `cdn` loads three@0.160.0 from jsDelivr.

seo._howTo: Carried over from the live WordPress site so Google Search Console stays verified after launch.
